lines.text: Outer lane's giving way! Keep going!
Never! Hold on to me, Zippy!
Whoa... sixty years of dust and not one tire track!
The scoreboard's stuck on the final lap... like it's waiting for us.
And the trophy case has a keyhole... our key might open it!
Don't open that case yet, Sprinkles. That scoreboard stopped for me... over sixty years ago.
You were here, Buster? What happened?
Come back to town with me. Your grandpa left a box in your garage.
Grandpa's dusty old box has a poster... Championship Final, five laps!
That speedway's been shut for decades. The track needs a safety check first.
I'm Hydro, Rescue Team. We check each sector before it opens for racing.
Fine, inspect it. I'm still the fastest car in town.
Your grandpa and I raced there long ago. I was number seven.
You raced Grandpa Cone?!
Fifth and final lap. Your grandpa was right in front of me. That close.
Last lap, Buster! Stay close!
Not for long, Cone!
Cone! The road fell out from under me... I'm stuck!
I'm not leaving you, Buster!
A trophy gets dusty, Buster. A friend never does.
Thank you... Cone.
He traded his last lap for you, Buster. Now we finish that lap for him... together!
Sector Three stays closed until it's inspected. Short loop only: Sectors One and Two.
Nice and safe. Four cars, one short loop. Racers... start your engines!
Sprinkles, Nitro, Zippy and Rocky... one short loop, and the mud is already hungry!
And it's Nitro and Zippy out front!
Mud! The track swallowed their speed!
Slow is smooth... and smooth is fast.
That ice cream truck just dusted me in the mud?!
An ice cream truck outdrove me... my paint will never live this down!
Sprinkles rolls first in the Safety Sprint!
The short loop works... Now how do we clear Sector Three for Grandpa's real final lap?
I'm a racecar, not a broom!
Less complaining, more sweeping!
Eight tons of monster truck, and she didn't even creak.
Beams hold two heavy trucks at a time. Cross slowly, no passing on the span. I can't test for falling rock.
Structure checked and cleared. Prepare for one official tribute lap... the Grandpa Cone Memorial Lap!
Rescue team in position at the bridge access. Winch anchored. If a car slips, I'm on the span in seconds.
Beat you to the bridge, ice cream. Then we crawl across, no passing.
I'm ready. This lap belongs to Grandpa.
For Grandpa Cone, and every racer who puts friends first. Ready... set... GO!
Green flag on the Memorial Lap! Nitro out front, Zippy right there!
The hill looms! Sprinkles is dropping back!
Build your speed before the hill... and keep rolling!
Keep rolling, Sprinkles!
Sprinkles roars past Nitro at the summit!
Nice try, ice cream! Nobody passes me twice!
Nitro, she's right behind you again!
Not for long. Into the canyon!
I'm clear on this side. I'll keep the exit open!
Hold the exit, Nitro. We finish together, or not at all.
Cable is on Zippy's tow ring. Stay still. I'm taking the load.
Not budging, Hydro!
Zippy first, then Sprinkles, then Rocky. One car at a time on the inner lane. Steady pace.
We're all safe on the straightaway. Time to cross that line as a team!
Four cars hit the old finish line as one!
Memorial Lap complete. No one crossed alone today.
This one's for you, Grandpa. And for you, Buster.
I'm so proud of you, Sprinkles. And I think Grandpa would be too.
Free ice cream for everyone who kept that bridge standing!
Grandpa's unfinished lap was finally complete... and his blueprint showed another mountain road waiting to be explored.
